no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) for this BLA. The Division has been attempting to obtain the advice of a Special Government Employee (SGE), a practicing oncologist with expertise in MCC and a patient advocate; however, clearance for these SGEs was not able to be obtained prior to the completion date for this review.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for BLA761049 (BAVENCIO/avelumab for Merkel cell carcinoma). The FDA multidisciplinary review states the Division did not obtain ODAC advice, and its attempt to consult Special Government Employees could not be cleared before the review completion date. The filing review likewise noted an AdComm was not needed because the biologic is not the first in its class, so there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
